title: AnalysisDocument
description: gitnebula analysis.json — the single interface between the pipeline and the Viewer. Normative source of the generated TypeScript types (AD-9).

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Major changes are breaking and require their own story plus an ADR (AD-9).

nodes.description: Modules and files. Sorted by id (ADR-0005).

edges.description: Import edges at both levels. Sorted by source then target (ADR-0005).

cochanges.description: Bounded co-change pairs, file-file and module-module. Sorted by count descending then ids (ADR-0005).

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Architectural layer assigned by the scanner's rule table (ADR-0002).

nodeKind.title: NodeKind
nodeKind.description: A node is either a module (a derived directory grouping) or a file.

name.description: Repository name, derived from the remote or the directory.

remoteUrl.description: Origin remote URL, or null when the repository has no remote.

analyzedAt.description: Run start instant. The only field allowed to differ between two runs on identical repo state (ADR-0005).

analysisWindowDays.description: Length of the analysis window in days. The window lives here, never in field names (ADR-0003).

languages.description: Language name to share of analyzed lines, in 0..1.

id.description: Stable node identifier, unique across the document.

parent.description: Id of the owning module, or null for a top-level node. Membership is expressed only here — there are no membership edges (ADR-0005).

churn.description: Normalized commit activity: min(1, commits / P95(commits over same-kind nodes with at least one commit)) (ADR-0003).

commits.description: Commits in the analysis window touching this node. Module commits are counted directly, never summed from files (ADR-0003).

authors.description: Distinct authors in the analysis window.

lastChangedAt.description: Most recent commit instant touching this node, or null when the node has no history in the repository.

description.description: Reserved for the post-MVP describe layer. Present, required and null-valued in MVP (AD-10).

descriptionSource.description: Reserved for the post-MVP describe layer. Present, required and null-valued in MVP (AD-10).

weight.description: For a module edge, the number of underlying file-level import pairs; for a file edge, 1 (ADR-0005).

cochange.title: CochangePair
cochange.description: An unordered pair of same-kind nodes that changed together. Bounds (count threshold, per-kind cap) are analyzer policy, not contract shape (PRD FR-7).

count.description: Commits in the analysis window touching both nodes.
